title: Hiram of Tyre
summary: Son of Abibalus and king of Tyre in Menander, contemporary with Solomon (Cory 1876).
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 28; Menander of Ephesus, ap. Josephus
reign.note: Hiromus [Hiram], son of Abibalus. Abibalus is named and given no length, so he has no record.

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 29; Menander of Ephesus, ap. Josephus
reign.note: Synchronism only. Menander names Solomon in Hiram's reign and gives Solomon no year.
